Do not post undisclosed vulnerabilities here. Use
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/OxiBelt/browntls/security/advisories/new).

## Problem

Describe expected and actual behavior, affected commit, environment, and safe
reproduction steps. Sanitize logs and omit secrets.

## Assistance

State whether an LLM agent participated. If so, include an `Assisted-by` notice
identifying the actual agent.
